newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel pleased with Yankee bond issue.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel pleased with Yankee bond issue.

text.p: Finance Minister Trevor Manuel said in a statement on Monday he was delighted with the U.S. response to South Africa's first Yankee bond issue.

"We were very pleased with the investor response to the issue, which was such that the demand at the launch on Friday exceeded the availability, resulting in a positive pricing of 195 basis points over the 10-year U.S. Treasury," he said.
The $300 million bond, with a 8.375 percent coupon, was issued after a South African tour to nine cities including New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Denver.
